title: Slices, Maps and Structs
story: Chilaka needs to store many things. Go has three friends for that.
goal: Learn slices, maps and structs, then check yourself.

tests.label: Finish every try-it and quick check

hints: Read each block, then do the TRY IT and QUICK CHECK parts.
Every interactive block must be done to finish the lesson.
Take your time. Nothing here is timed.
socratic: Compare your result with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the most useful thing you learned here?

blocks.text: A **slice** is a growing list. A **map** looks things up by key. A **struct** groups named fields into one value.

blocks.title: All three

blocks.why: append returns the new slice, so you assign it back: nums = append(nums, 4).

blocks.prompt: Make a slice of two strings and add a third.
blocks.why: append grows a slice, and len counts it.

blocks.q: What does a map return for a key that is not there?
blocks.why: Reading a missing key gives the zero value for the type.
